stories.title: Game Recap — Brewers Walk Off Cubs in 10 Innings
stories.angle: Jackson Chourio hit a two-out homer in the 9th to tie it; Luis Lara singled home the walkoff run in the 10th. Cubs drop Game 2, fall 0-2 in Milwaukee. David Peterson started for Chicago; Jacob Misiorowski for Milwaukee.

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Jackson Chourio. Two outs. Ninth inning. Gone.

Luis Lara walked off the Cubs in the 10th an inning later. Cubs drop Game 2 in Milwaukee and fall 0-2 in the series. Still 81-65 with 16 games left.

Gausman answers tonight at 6:40 PM CT.

#Cubs #GoCubs #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Game 3 Preview — Gausman vs Henderson, Avoid the Sweep
stories.angle: Kevin Gausman (9-11, 4.38 ERA) faces Logan Henderson (9-3, 2.48 ERA) at American Family Field. Cubs must win tonight to avoid being swept by the division leaders with 16 games left.

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Logan Henderson: 9-3, 2.48 ERA. He's been the best arm in this series.

Kevin Gausman gets the ball tonight at American Family Field. 6:40 PM CT. Cubs need a win — they're getting swept by the NL's best otherwise.

The ace. The moment. Game 3.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Watch — 41 HR / 35 SB, Five Away
stories.angle: PCA moved to 41 HR / 35 SB (up from 40/33 on Sept 7). Five stolen bases from joining the most exclusive club in baseball. Only 6 players in MLB history have done it. No Cub ever has. 16 games remain.

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong: 41 HR / 35 SB.

Five stolen bases from the most exclusive club in baseball. Only six players in MLB history have hit 40 homers and stolen 40 bases in a season. No Cub has ever done it.

16 games. PCA is five away.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Ian Happ Knee — October Availability at Risk
stories.angle: Happ has missed multiple straight games with left knee discomfort since Sept 6. Day-to-day, but an IL placement at this point would threaten his postseason availability. He's been hitting .275 over his last 15 games with 13 RBI.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
Ian Happ: .275 over his last 15 games, 13 RBI — one of the Cubs' hottest bats.

He's missed multiple straight games with left knee discomfort since Sept 6. An IL trip at this point would put his October at real risk.

Counsell needs him back.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Pre-Game Hype — Gausman Must Deliver
stories.angle: Cubs facing sweep by the NL's best team with 16 games left. Henderson (2.48 ERA) is the stiffest challenge of the series. Gausman needs to be the ace tonight. The Cubs' playoff positioning depends on getting this one.

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
AVOID THE SWEEP. 6:40 PM CT. American Family Field.

Logan Henderson (2.48 ERA) is the toughest start left in this series. Gausman has to be better than his season numbers tonight.

Cubs are 81-65. There's no give left in this schedule.
